title: Understanding the Graph and Table
text: The graph shows the positions of points A, B, C, D, and E in a 2D space. The table provides the Euclidean distances between each pair of points. Use these distances to determine the smallest weight for the spectral clustering graph.

title: Identifying the Smallest Distance
text: Look at the distance table. Identify the pair of points with the smallest distance. This will correspond to the edge with the smallest weight in the graph.
